messages:
kevin: Auditor (Evelyn) pinged — they need an evidence package for KMS usage and RBAC changes covering 2025-01-01..2025-03-31. Deadline EOD Fri. Can eng-security confirm what artifacts we can pull and recommended sample sizes? cc @maria @sam

maria: We can pull CloudTrail/KMS events and authz-service audit lines. Need to clarify whether they want raw events or a packaged CSV + manifest. Also: do they want encrypt/decrypt only or full key administration events?

evelyn-auditor: Prefer a small sample of 10 end-to-end encrypt/decrypt operations for production keys (include caller identity + request IDs), full key rotation/change history for any CMKs in scope, and the full RBAC change log (role assignments, grants, policy updates) for that date range. Please map each artifact to SOC 2 / ISO controls (high-level mapping is fine).

sam: For RBAC: authz-service emits change events to prod-logs (ELK) and we also have Okta system logs for SCIM/role provisioning. Okta exports are accessible via the admin API and we keep a daily dump in s3://redwood-exports/okta-logs/.

maria: Suggested artifact list:
- cloudtrail_kms_<range>.jsonl (filtered to eventSource = "kms.amazonaws.com", EventName in {Encrypt,Decrypt,GenerateDataKey,ReEncrypt,ScheduleKeyDeletion})
- kms_key_history.csv (DescribeKey + rotation status + CreateDate + LastRotation)
- authz_changes_<range>.ndjson (role grant/revoke, policy_update events from authz-service)
- okta_systemlog_<range>.json (export from Okta admin API)
- evidence_manifest.md (mapping artifact -> control(s), extraction command, sample IDs)
- sample_correlation.csv (correlated CloudTrail eventId <-> app x-request-id)

kevin: Can you paste the exact commands/queries we’ll use so the auditor can verify reproduction?

maria: Yep — rough CLI / Logs Insights snippets below (redact as needed):

AWS CLI / CloudTrail (lookup and export to S3):
```
# lookup events with KMS as the source
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-03-31T23:59:59Z --max-results 50 > cloudtrail_kms_2025Q1.json

# For full export, export CloudTrail to S3 via console or create an export task in CloudTrail -> Event data store
```

CloudWatch Logs Insights (authz-service):
```
# example query to get role change events
fields @timestamp, @message | filter service = "authz-service" and (message like /grant/ or message like /revoke/ or message like /policy_update/) | sort @timestamp desc | limit 200
```

Okta export (admin API):
```
curl -H "Authorization: SSWS $OKTA_TOKEN" "https://{org}.okta.com/api/v1/logs?since=2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z&until=2025-03-31T23:59:59.999Z" > okta_systemlog_Q1.json
```

KMS Describe / rotation info:
```
aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/production-app | jq '.' > kms_key_meta.json
aws kms list-resource-tags --key-id alias/production-app
# rotation status from describe-key -> KeyRotationStatus
```

maria: Note: older logs >90 days may be archived (CloudTrail event data store -> S3 Glacier). If auditor wants historic raw logs we need a retrieval request and that adds ~24-48h. Call it out in the manifest.

evelyn-auditor: Also need to see how you correlate a KMS event to an application-level request (who/why). If you can provide a sample join showing x-request-id -> CloudTrail eventId that would be great.

maria: We'll include a sample_correlation.csv with 10 rows. App front-end logs include x-request-id header which we log to app-requests index; we can join on that ID to CloudTrail requestParameters.ciphertextBlob or requestID. We'll redact account IDs.

kevin: Auditor also asked about vulnerability triage evidence for authz-service (they flagged CVE-2024-XXXX). We have an open ticket. Can we include the triage and mitigation evidence?

sam: Triage ticket INFRA-412 (link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INFRA-412) — contains timeline, patch PR, test run ids, and deployment. We can include the IR ticket export + PR diff + deploy tags.

nina: I’ll assemble the package. Plan: pull logs, run queries, put artifacts in s3://compliance-packages/2025Q1/evelyn-request/, generate evidence_manifest.md, and create a signed zip for upload. ETA: 48 hours unless Glacier retrieval needed.

maria: Packaging checklist for manifest content:
- artifact filename, extraction command, md5 checksum, covered control IDs (SOC2 / ISO ref), redaction notes, retrieval notes (if from Glacier).
- sample IDs for auditor verification (10 sample eventIds + corresponding x-request-id)
- contact: eng-security@redwood.ai for follow-up

deploy-bot: export job started: s3://compliance-packages/2025Q1/evelyn-request/partial_export_001 (will update when done) :package:

kevin: Great. Evelyn — will this meet your request? Anything else besides mapping to SOC2/ISO and the correlation sample?

evelyn-auditor: This looks good. One more ask: include the change approval record for RBAC updates (Jira approval comments or Slack approvals) for the sampled events. We need evidence of approval workflow.

maria: We'll include the approval comments from the Jira tickets and any linked PRs; if approvals were via Slack threads I'll capture the permalink (we can redact unrelated convos).

kevin: Ok — proceed. Nina, Sam, Maria — please coordinate and ping me with progress. I'll update the auditor on expected delivery M-F window. :thumbsup:
